authorization: User requests every GG widget reproduced for DG, published at gg&dg on GitHub. Explicit reply: План ДГ пока не задан. Existing GG metric definitions are inherited, never GG targets. Follow-up: remove requested plan, dynamics, manager, production, data-discipline and offer-control widgets; swap speed/loss widgets before deal funnel; add deal/sales switch, zero rings and lead/deal reason tables.

population.deals: Exact SOURCE_ID OR LEAD_ID in eligible leads; unique ID
population.enrichment: Stage history, direct lead/deal activities and linked production items only. Shared contact/company communication cannot be attributed to DG and is excluded.

reference.runtimeVersion: Manifest SHA-256 of actual template used by Pages

period: Inclusive Moscow dates. Lead cohort by creation. GG default 30 days, weekly buckets. User can select dates, month, granularity, creation/outcome date basis and created/active funnel modes. Current day partial. Open-pipeline and discipline widgets operate on the current open inventory where the GG reference does so.
conversion: GG CR1 = converted leads / same lead creation cohort. CR2 and success rates use GG selected cohort/outcome basis and displayed denominators. Ratios are descriptive CRM metrics, not controlled acquisition attribution or fixed-maturation conversion.
money: GG prepayment/won mode and budget/prepayment amount switches are preserved. Default prepayment event uses first EXECUTING stage, then first later stage in history, then close-date fallback for a won record; amount uses selected CRM field. Open pipeline = current opportunity, not bank revenue. No refunds/tax/accounting inference. RUB/category 49 contract checked before publication.
plan: All plan UI and sales-health widgets removed; no GG targets imported.
production: GG transfer event and SP1086 link/quantity fields, restricted to eligible deal IDs. Zero linked items is known empty, not unavailable. No sales/production assumed when missing.
manager: Current assigned managers from DG data, including inactive owners. System/non-sales accounts stay in totals/unallocated rows. Manager cards filter the same DG page; no link to all-source personal dashboards.
privacy: Customer titles/photos and credentials excluded. Directly bound DG communication text/subjects and reason notes included by user request. Contact masking retained, all URLs and credential-like markers redacted; IDs plain text. Per-record JSON authenticated and scoped; no raw snapshot or credentials in Git.
freshness: Independent VPS refresh every 15 minutes. Private raw snapshot; atomic publication retains last successful release on failure. Input older than 24 hours fails validation. Source and build timestamps remain visible.
limitations: Live CRM and GG snapshot share a source family. No external financial reconciliation. Unsupported future currency/category fails publication explicitly; parent source changes must satisfy adapter contracts. No DG sales plan exists.

distribution.default: Deals, count; FD creation cohort with current global filters, every status.
distribution.sales: Original GG soldSet: selected prepayment/won mode and creation/outcome dates.
distribution.money: Deals use opportunity; sales use selected opportunity/prepayment amount. Missing opportunity is counted separately. RUB only.
distribution.invariants: All categories retained; sum of category counts equals selected records, sum of monetary categories equals selected known amounts. Zero totals show gray rings, never fake segments.

drilldown.leads: Lead funnel opens same FL creation cohort; refusal chart is nonclickable. Calendar refusals expand by operational reason then current manager, record and full communication history.
drilldown.deals: A distribution category opens the same selected deals/sales subset. IDs are plain text; includes owner, dates, stage, loss reason, budget/prepayment, originating lead, source/client/product and touch/task dates.
drilldown.privacy: Only exact known operational labels are published from lead string fields. Other text becomes Другая причина (см. CRM); missing = Не заполнена. Deal free text stays in CRM.
drilldown.reasonDenominator: Refused leads in selected status/funnel subset, before optional reason/search filtering. Number and share are displayed explicitly.

layout.order: Lead funnel and reasons, then deal funnel. Main cross-conversion is vertical with unchanged lead/qualified/sales values.

calendar.population: All current source-eligible DG leads/deals, irrespective of their creation date when counting later stage events.
calendar.dates: Inclusive Europe/Moscow dates; current day partial.
calendar.leadLost: First historical F semantic entry; reason/current assignee from current CRM card.

wip.formula: Latest history event at min(bucket end 23:59:59.999+03:00,snapshot time) is this stage with P semantics. Period total is final stock, not sum of buckets.

stages.lost: First F semantic deal history event

calendar.eventPolicy: First lifetime entry only; repeat entries do not inflate counts. History completeness/current-stage consistency required before publication. Different stage rows are not additive.
calendar.money: Lead: known RUB opportunity, missing/foreign currency flagged. Deal: selected amount field. Manager table budget labelled separately.
calendar.manager: Current responsible manager, not historical owner.

comparison: Previous adjacent interval has the same inclusive number of days as selected period. If previous metric is zero/absent, neutral 0% placeholder with tooltip. Otherwise (current-previous)/abs(previous).
access: Dedicated DG Basic Auth on TLS /gg-dg/ only. No common API, no legacy fallback. Code and raw data live outside shared www/current. Both former GitHub Pages routes are removed (404), without redirects.
planPresentation: All plan controls, notices and calendar plan strips are removed. Sales health is removed. Factual metric definitions are unchanged.

communications.authorization: User asks all communications for DG leads/deals with Dialog table hierarchy.
sources: Complete Bitrix activity lists filtered by exact BINDINGS
Existing read-only loopback Dialog cache, only eligible L/D keys
communications.dedup: Global source ID act#/cmt#; union of direct eligible bindings. Converted lead cache events can live under D-key but original entity stage is rechecked. Deal history includes originating eligible lead; aggregate counts use distinct event IDs.
communications.types: Calls/email/messages/SMS count as communications; tasks/notes/service/stages are separate events.
communications.period: Full record history on expansion; calendar period only highlights relevant events.
communications.delivery: Lazy static communications/L<id>.json or D<id>.json protected by dedicated DG Basic Auth; no arbitrary proxy. Payload generation must equal page generation.
communications.security: Contact mask, escaped text, no links/webhooks/keys/AI actions; existing transcripts only, no model or Telegram API use.
communications.coverage: Source API visibility applies. Dialog freshness is explicit and can lag. Missing cache is a labelled gap, not zero communication. No claim of recovering deleted/unavailable CRM content.
